openings.claim: A cutoff-aware row ledger makes supported lineage, rather than report recency, determine reconciliation; explicit replacement edges separate quantity agreement from transaction-identity agreement. Retain every original, duplicate and unmatched row with batch, original quantity/unit, converted quantity, status interpretation and disposition. Use only U=5V. Activate supersession only through explicit references and effective-time/cutoff checks. Equal quantities under different row identifiers indicate candidate correspondence, never identity proof.
openings.discriminator: Against taking the newer report as authoritative after conversion, predict exposure of inconsistent counting involving a pre-cutoff amendment and an older replacement quantity. Predict explicit uncertainty for the disturbed missing superseded-row reference and undefined status, instead of unsupported definite quantities. Defeat advantage if the key shows no reduction in unsupported claims, incorrect lineage handling, or fewer justified resolutions without compensating accuracy.
openings.probe: Implement ledger and recency-rival variants in the supplied spreadsheet/script environment over sixty rows, eight amendments and twelve identifiers. Run both on supplied clean and disturbed copies within the shared sixty-minute review budget. Freeze outputs before opening the sealed key. Use twenty extra minutes to compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts; check complete row dispositions and record citations. Parsing/setup failure within budget means infeasible, not successful.
openings.uncertainty: These are predictions, not results. Explicit references and the supplied dictionary permit some unambiguous dispositions; assume no unstated cross-report identity mapping. Capacity within sixty minutes remains unverified; feasible execution and benefit are unmeasured.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, rival/disturbance predictions, defeat conditions, constraints, resource caveats and declared preserves fit.

decision: Test D1. Produce twelve cited batch results: supported definite quantities or bounded disagreements; never infer missing quantities. Issue at most three requests naming missing fields/records, grouping identifiers sharing a missing field; leave remaining uncertainty explicit. Reject operational suitability for exceeding sixty minutes, exceeding three requests, or any hard-constraint failure. No deployment or additional records are authorized.
